'''Nor Chasen''' is a small village in southern [[Altara]], located east of [[Ebou Dar]].

Nor Chasen is a port village. The precise location is uncertain, however it is not on [[Kabal Deep]], where the coast does not possess any good haroborages according to the [[Seanchan]]. When two men try to kidnap [[Matrim Cauthon]], they claimed that they were passing through Ebou Dar on their way to Nor Chasen.{{ref/book|7|17}}
